critical_code_review_comments: ProposedSolutionSection.js (565 lines) is well-organized; pure autoCalc engine + _overrides tracking is clean. Suggestion: AutoField & DriverField are defined inside the parent component on every render — this causes React to remount the <Input> on each render, which is why focus/IME may be reset while typing on slow devices. Move them to module scope or wrap with useCallback returning JSX-builder fns. Not blocking — typing works because controlled value re-attaches — but slight perf/UX nit.

useEffect that pushes engine values back into parent runs on every engine recompute and uses JSON.stringify(overrides) inside useMemo deps. The patch comparison via String(newVal) !== String(data[f]) is good defensive equality; lastPushed ref prevents infinite loops. Verified no console errors / no infinite re-render in 90s of interaction.

Math correctness verified end-to-end against spec; subsidy cap at ₹78,000 enforced (>2 kW domestic on-grid). cost_per_kWp map {on-grid:55000, hybrid:75000, off-grid:95000} produces correct totals on system_type switch.

Iter-33 regression: project-notes-card and site_docs project-notes-input still visible in source (verified earlier iter); ProposedSolutionSection still rendered inside materials step (line 865 of SiteVisitForm.js).
seed_data_creation: None — wizard exercised in-memory; no project was submitted (Auto Calculate / overrides / smart recalc are all client-state). Persistence (feature #10) was not exercised end-to-end via UI submit, but the data flows through formData.custom_fields.proposed_solution = ps (SiteVisitForm.js line 869) and the create_project endpoint already accepts custom_fields verbatim (verified in iter-33). Recommend a single smoke test by the main agent: POST /api/projects with custom_fields.proposed_solution = {...AUTO_FIELDS, _overrides: {system_size_kw:true}, _derived: {...}} → GET should round-trip the entire object.
